scripts.build: npm install --prefix back && npm install --prefix front && npm run build --prefix front
scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev --prefix back" "npm run dev --prefix front"
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix back && npm install --prefix front
scripts.lint: npm run lint --prefix back && npm run lint --prefix front
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --prefix back && npm run typecheck --prefix front
